title: Xcel Energy to temporarily close fishing access at Thornapple Dam

body_markdown:
Eau Claire, Wis- (Sept. 28, 2026) –Xcel Energy will be performing repairs to the Thornapple Dam powerhouse and to accommodate that work, the west side fishing access will be closed beginning Monday, Sept. 28 through Nov. 6.


The boat landing and tailwater fishing access on the east side will remain open. Xcel Energy reminds recreational and fishing enthusiasts to be safe around dams and hydroelectric facilities and to be aware of all warning signs, barriers, flashing lights, horns and sirens.


# # #


Xcel Energy operates 19 hydroelectric plants in Wisconsin on eight rivers with a total generating capacity of about 270 megawatts. ****
